title: 疫情后：资本成本不降反升，主权债压力会否加剧？
speaker: Tracy Chen

segments.en: Yeah, I think I have been witnessing this regime change pre-COVID versus post-COVID.
segments.zh: 我一直在观察疫情前后的体制变化。

segments.en: So pre-COVID, we have so many savings and then you don't have enough investment. So the cost of capital is so low, we have adsorb or actually negative real, real yield.
segments.zh: 疫情前储蓄过剩、配置不足，资本成本极低，甚至实际收益率接近零或为负。

segments.en: But post-COVID, we have massive government spending and there's a wealth transfer from government sector to private sector.
segments.zh: 但疫情后，政府支出巨大，财富从政府部门转移到私营部门。

segments.en: Household has been locking very low mortgage rate and corporate. They have been refined refinance their debt to get very low cost of capital.
segments.zh: 家庭锁定了很低的按揭利率，企业也通过再融资获得很低的资本成本。

segments.en: So right now we are very constructive on both households and corporate and less. Or I can say negative on the sovereign, especially DM sovereign because the fiscal picture is just very ugly.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们对家庭和企业部门较为乐观，但对主权债尤其是发达市场主权债持谨慎态度，因为财政状况不佳。

segments.en: So I would say we are more constructive on credit rather than the DM sovereigns. I think yield will stay high for longer if not going higher for longer.
segments.zh: 所以我们对信用债比主权债更乐观。我认为收益率将保持高位，甚至可能更高。

segments.en: And inflation will also be elevated because there are just too much fiscal spending.
segments.zh: 通胀也会保持高位，因为财政支出太多。
